input.range: 0..1 (the *255 YOLOX rescale is baked into the graph)

output.fields: [cx, cy, w, h, obj, cls0..3] in 416-px space (decode folded in)

provenance: Recovered from the cancelled honghuanwu/hoopai-train-yolox v4 Kaggle run via its live checkpoint-promoter (epoch 20 of 40).
wired: Opt-in via Settings > Detector engine (beta) = YOLOX. Default off.
